top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Gudie to first aid and emergency care (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The guide was missing from the first aid kit.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have a copy of their educational documents on file for review.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The 5 staff files reviewed did not have form 2912 included.
